name: Boxing Conditioning A
notes: Monday session from the practical Tyson split: jump rope, push-ups, dips, squats, core, then bag rounds. Tap Start on a timed round — when it hits zero, rest starts automatically (1:00). Leave 1–3 reps in reserve on push-ups and dips. Pair with B on Wednesday and C on Friday.

name: Boxing Conditioning B
notes: Wednesday session: easy bike warm-up, pulling, shrugs, neck, plank, then short sprints. The warm-up is cardio — tick it and keep moving; rest starts after pull-ups, shrugs, and timed work. Neck holds are gentle; stop if you feel dizziness or radiating pain. Rest is 1:00. Pair with A on Monday and C on Friday.

name: Boxing Conditioning C
notes: Friday full-body circuit plus bag work. Stay relaxed on the rope, stop push-ups before form breaks, and keep shadowboxing on defense and counters. Tap Start on timed rounds — rest starts at zero (1:00). Use this with A on Monday and B on Wednesday.

name: Incline Walk
notes: Fat-loss incline walking only. Each block has time, speed, and incline; distance fills in automatically when you tick a block, or type what the treadmill shows. Tick a block when it ends and keep walking — the rest timer does not start for cardio work. Aim for 4–5 sessions a week, and log body weight on the Progress tab.
